# Ntombis Fashion

> Ntombis Fashion (short name: NTB Fashions) is a South African fashion brand based in {{CITY}}, {{PROVINCE}}. It makes shweshwe and Ankara ready-to-wear, accessories, and bespoke outfits for matric dances, weddings and traditional ceremonies. Jewellery is made with partner Nolty Jewellers.

## Bespoke
Made-to-measure outfits for matric dances, weddings (brides, grooms, bridal parties), traditional and cultural ceremonies, and red-carpet events. Start with a consultation on WhatsApp.
